subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact `~`/`$OPENCLAW_HOME` path display by default, switch agent-visible paths to full absolute paths by default, or add an explicit full-path display preference?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally preserve compact display, while the requested behavior changes a user-facing default or adds configuration surface that needs maintainer product intent.

options.title: Keep Compact Default
options.body: Preserve compact `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` display as the default and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

options.title: Use Absolute Paths By Default
options.body: Change shared display helpers and agent prompt/display paths so home-contained paths render as full absolute paths by default.

options.title: Add Explicit Display Preference
options.body: Introduce a documented opt-in setting or environment variable for full absolute paths while keeping current compact defaults.

recommendation.title: Keep Compact Default
recommendation.body: Preserve compact `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` display as the default and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the central display-policy helper is the commit that introduced `shortenHomePath` in `src/utils.ts`.
